high_level_description: This image appears to be a screenshot from an Instagram post by the user "tchalamet," as indicated by the username at the top of the image. The person is facing away from the camera, wearing a vibrant orange varsity jacket with blue sleeves and a large circular emblem on the back featuring an eagle and some text. The number "3" is prominently displayed on the sleeve
